THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT WAS REACHED BY STIPULATION. PLAINTIFF, PACIFIC EQUITIES, SHALL RECEIVE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF 1353 BUSH,#201, SAN FRANCISCO. A WRIT OF EXECUTION MAY ISSUE BUT WILL BE STAYED UNTIL 3-5-94. IF DEFENDANT, LEE ANN DAVIES, VACATES ON OR BEFORE 3-5-94, A MONEY JUDGMENT OF $200 SHALL BE OWED. IF DEFENDANT, LEE ANN DAVIES, VACATES AFTER 3-5-94, THE MONEY JUDGMENT SHALL BE FOR $800. NO OTHER PARTIES ARE LIVING ON THE PREMISES EXCEPT DEFENDANT, LEE ANN DAVIES.
